title: Azusawa Kohane — Wanting To Grow Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hm? Is it just you, Aoyagi?
Where are An and Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They said that they won't be able to make it to practice today, so we'll just be doing solo practices.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's alright with me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But does that mean something happened between An and Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd actually like to ask you about that...
Weekend
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Kohane.
Everyone else is already here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I heard that you're studying for exams?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not me but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These two...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This wasn't supposed to happen...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What happened with Tono left you with no time for schoolwork?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, exams happened before that and has nothing to do with this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I told them so many times to be mindful of these things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think they know, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everybody makes mistakes, so let's try not to worry too much about failing a couple tests, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, who said I failed?
I passed... Barely...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, for my own sake, please don't pin that kind of thing on me...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? But you said that you have to take a make-up...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The make-up includes not just the ones who failed but those within ten points of failing as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's why they're making you take it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So how many points above failing were you two?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Eight points.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nine...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?! You were so close!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
If you round up, that's ten! There's no point in us taking the make-up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's not the point. You're well below the average, so there is reason for you to have to take it again.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As tough as this sounds, try your best. I'll try to find some good studying music in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll even throw in some drinks.
Promise to study hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I, um... I'll help too!
Don't worry, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...!
Thank you so much!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, we should get started...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi's on Classics and Akito has to do English. I'll help Akito with English, and Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. I'll help An with Classics.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, do you have your exam with you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you missed a lot of points in the vocab section...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito did the same thing.
Having a good vocabulary usually makes everything else much easier...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If only you gave this as much attention as you do when it comes to singing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was trying to do things efficiently...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Guessing which questions will most likely be asked isn't the same as studying efficiently...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, fine. My bad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's get started too, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This phrase usually means...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Interesting, charming, cute or something along the lines of being touching in some way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right, I get that...!
But this other one, uh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, spoon feeding her answers won't help her learn that stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In the event that they do fail the make-up exam, they'll be forced to take classes on the weekend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They'll even be put on the secret blacklist of students with bad grades that the teachers made.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! A blacklist...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you actually believe in stuff like that? There's no way something like that actually exists.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, there's no way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But there's also the saying, Where there's smoke, there's fire.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Does that mean something like that could actually exist...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do we do if they do put An on the blacklist...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, everyone else might start making fun of her for that too...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Look, it's Shiraishi. I heard she had to take a make-up again after she bombed it the first time.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Aww, poor her...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey, how about we have Shiraishi do all our homework so she'll get better at studying?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane!! Help me!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, An... An...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An..!
We have to keep trying! I don't want to see anyone make you do their homework for them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Me doing other people's homework...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's okay, An!
You're not going on the blacklist!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's just start by expanding your vocabulary! Try to memorize everything on these two pages in the next ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
H-Hold on, Kohane...
Wait, two pages in ten minutes?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya, why did you have to say that?! Kohane's not gonna show me any mercy now...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you'll have to move at least at that pace to get through this today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You too, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They might be at this a while.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're probably right.
